How to play

Two teams, Blue and Red, each have a harbor with 25,000 health. Sink ships, shoot down planes and bomb the enemy harbor. The first harbor to hit zero loses. When time runs out, the healthier harbor wins.

Earn gold by doing damage, getting kills and claiming islands, then spend it on bigger warships and planes. Claim the five neutral islands by parking ships next to them: each one gives your team turrets, a forward spawn and more gold. An aircraft carrier is a floating airfield: while it is afloat, everyone on your team can launch planes from it.

Online: ▶ PLAY puts you in the one shared battle. It is always full of bots, and each real player who joins takes a bot's place on the side with fewer real players. When a match ends, the next one starts by itself. 🔒 Private room makes a room just for you and friends (send them its code), and 🤖 Practice is offline against bots.
